patterns.note: Full-bleed editorial photography dominates hero and key section introductions, creating an immersive visual experience with minimal UI elements.
A sophisticated serif typeface is used for the main brand identity and key section titles, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A muted, sophisticated palette of deep charcoal/navy, crisp white, and natural earth tones from photography, with minimal accent colors used sparingly for interaction.
Hero sections feature a subtle parallax effect where large background images scroll slower than foreground text and overlays, creating a sense of depth.
Prominent, full-width image-based hero sections introduce content, often with overlaid uppercase text, followed by structured product grids.

technique_notes: The site employs large, full-bleed background images in hero sections that exhibit a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the image moves at a slower rate than the foreground content, enhancing depth. This effect is likely achieved using JavaScript (e.g., webgl-three or custom scroll-triggered animation).
A sticky header is implemented, featuring the brand logo and main navigation links, which remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Product listings are presented in a responsive grid layout, where individual product cards maintain consistent spacing and alignment, often with hover effects for details or calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif display font (~4-5x body) for brand identity, with clear, legible sans-serifs for headings (~2-3x body) and body text. Many labels are small and uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a structured, consistent grid for product displays.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-fashion editorial photography as dominant, full-bleed visual elements, combined with a sophisticated, almost minimalist typographic hierarchy, elevates the e-commerce experience beyond a typical product catalog into a curated brand narrative.
